anchors.description: Front width of the black under-counter dishwasher between its vertical left and right front-face edges.
anchors.visible_evidence: Black appliance beneath the countertop with a horizontal control/button strip at the top right and a recessed horizontal handle bar; its planar black front panel is flush with the adjacent wood base cabinets, matching a standard built-in dishwasher installed at 24 in nominal width.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Possible compact 18-in dishwasher, although the wide front and long handle favor the 24-in class; a 24-in trash compactor shares the same nominal width. Right edge lies close to the refrigerator side panel, so a few pixels of the front may be occluded.
